title.ja: 地震のとき外国人を案内する
title.en: Helping a tourist after an earthquake

summary.ja: 地震のあと、不安な観光客を落ち着かせて、避難場所や情報の集め方を伝える。
summary.en: After an earthquake, calm a worried tourist and tell them where to go and how to get news.

setting: A street near Kitamachi Station in Tokyo, a few minutes after a fairly strong earthquake. The shaking has stopped and no one is hurt, but the trains have stopped for safety checks. A tourist standing nearby looks frightened.

roles.persona: A Japanese person who lives in the area and stays calm.

levels.tutor: You are a frightened tourist who has never felt an earthquake. You are not hurt. Speak slowly and simply, and follow the local. Ask what happened and where to go. Use the evacuation map.

hints: 大丈夫か声をかけましょう
Are you …?
Are you okay?

title.ja: 揺れが止まったと伝える

hints: もう揺れは止まったと伝えて、安心させましょう
It's okay now. The shaking …
It's okay now. The shaking has stopped.

title.ja: 一緒に行こうと伝える

hints: 一緒に来てと伝えましょう
Come with …
Please come with me.
小学校に行こうと伝えましょう
Let's go to the …
Let's go to the elementary school.

levels.tutor: You are a worried tourist who isn't hurt, speaking at natural pace. Ask whether it's over, whether the trains are running, and where you should go. You want to message your family. Use the evacuation map.

hints: けががないか聞きましょう
Are you …?
Are you hurt at all?

title.ja: 電車の状況を説明する

hints: 安全確認で電車が止まっていると伝えましょう
The trains have stopped for …
The trains have stopped for safety checks.

title.ja: 余震について注意する

hints: また揺れるかもしれないので、窓から離れるよう伝えましょう
There may be more …, so stay away from …
There may be more shaking, so stay away from windows.
小学校が避難場所だと説明しましょう
Let's go to the … It's the …
Let's go to the elementary school. It's the evacuation area.
災害時の無料Wi-Fiを教えましょう
You can use the free Wi-Fi called …
You can use the free Wi-Fi called 00000JAPAN.

levels.tutor: You are a shaken tourist who isn't hurt, speaking at natural speed. Your hotel is in Midoribashi, two stops away, and you want to know how long the trains will be stopped and whether it's safe. You need to tell your family you're okay. Use the evacuation map.

title.ja: 落ち着かせて状況を説明する

hints: 地震は日本ではよくあり、建物も強いと伝えて安心させましょう
Don't worry. Earthquakes like this are …, and the buildings …
Don't worry. Earthquakes like this are common here, and the buildings are built for them.

title.ja: 電車の見通しを伝える
title.en: Say how long the trains may stop

hints: 安全確認に1時間以上かかるかもしれないと伝えましょう
The trains are stopped for … It could take …
The trains are stopped for checks. It could take an hour or more.
近くの小学校に一緒に行こうと誘いましょう
The elementary school … is the evacuation area. Let's …
The elementary school five minutes away is the evacuation area. Let's go together.

title.ja: 家族への連絡方法を伝える

hints: 災害用の無料Wi-Fiで家族に連絡できると伝えましょう
If you need to contact your family, the free Wi-Fi …
If you need to contact your family, the free Wi-Fi works in emergencies.

roles.persona: A tourist who has just felt their first earthquake.

levels.tutor: You are a calm local who lives in the area. Speak slowly and simply. Explain that it was an earthquake, the shaking has stopped, and you'll walk together to the elementary school on the evacuation map.

hints: 何が起きたか聞きましょう
What …?
What happened?
どこへ行けばいいか聞きましょう
Where should I …?
Where should I go?
お礼を言いましょう
Thank you …
Thank you so much.

levels.tutor: You are a calm local, speaking at natural pace. Explain that the trains have stopped for safety checks, that there may be aftershocks, and that the elementary school is the evacuation area. Mention the free Wi-Fi 00000JAPAN if asked.

hints: もう大丈夫か聞きましょう
Is it … now?
Is it safe now?
電車が動いているか聞きましょう
Are the trains …?
Are the trains still running?

title.ja: どこへ行けばいいか聞く

hints: どこへ行けばいいか聞きましょう
Where should I …?
Where should I go now?
使えるWi-Fiがあるか聞きましょう
Is there any Wi-Fi …?
Is there any Wi-Fi I can use?

levels.tutor: You are a calm local, speaking at natural speed. Reassure the tourist, explain the trains could be stopped for an hour or more, suggest going together to the elementary school, and explain the free emergency Wi-Fi from the evacuation map.

title.ja: 状況を伝えて相談する

hints: ホテルが2駅先なのに電車が止まっていると伝えて、相談しましょう
My hotel is in …, but the trains … What should I …?
My hotel is in Midoribashi, but the trains have stopped. What should I do?
また揺れるかもしれないか聞きましょう
Should I expect …?
Should I expect more shaking?

title.ja: 家族への連絡について聞く

hints: 家族に無事を伝えたいと言って、Wi-Fiがあるか聞きましょう
I need to tell my family … Is there …?
I need to tell my family I'm okay. Is there any Wi-Fi?

title.ja: 心をこめてお礼を言う

hints: 一緒にいてくれたことにお礼を言いましょう
Thank you for … I feel …
Thank you for staying with me. I feel much calmer now.
